overview: Crush a dropped item under a piston, an anvil or a falling column of sand and get experience back, worth what the item took to make.
And a few more ways for experience to move: mobs that die on their own pay a share, hoppers fill bottles, and a lectern binds experience into a book.

1.0.1: Prices are settled once when recipes load rather than worked out per crush, which is what used to take a tick past a minute and shut a server down.
An item pinned against a wall by a piston head counts as crushed, and operators get a settings page.
1.0.0: The first release: crushing by piston, anvil and falling column, with a harder hit paying more, and prices read off the recipe tree so a worn tool pays for what is left of it and a full shulker box pays for its contents.
Deaths nobody had a hand in pay a share, a hopper with an empty bottle in it fills bottles from orbs, and a book and quill on a lectern binds points into a Tome of Experience.
